text:
marta_cs: Quick heads up — Lakeshore Health renewal is 18 days out. Pricing is agreed but procurement flagged a vendor_code mismatch and now requires a PO with their vendor code. Also seeing a request from legal for a DPA + a small localization/data-residency clause. Customer wants to close this month; onboarding is still mid-journey (SAML metadata pending).

csm_jordan: Ack. Can you paste the exact vendor code they want? I can take point with procurement.

marta_cs: Vendor code they provided: LAKE-HLTH-01. Their procurement team will only accept invoices that include that code. DocuSign already sent, but approver stack changed (CFO removed, procurement manager added). docusign-bot said 2 approvers still pending.

 docusign-bot: DocuSign update: Envelope 0x9fa — 1 signature completed, 2 pending. Last action 2024-11-02T15:42Z.

sales_dan: If Legal insists on a DPA + residency sentence, we should check whether Lakeshore will accept a 6mo term instead of an annual commit. They had earlier asked about shorter terms. That affects pricing.

legal_jane: Looping in Legal. I'll review their DPA redlines now. Quick clarifying Q: is adding an optional EU residency reference acceptable as an amendment rather than editing the master SOW? Customer is US-headquartered but has an EU subsidiary.

marta_cs: They want the residency sentence as an optional clause for future use — not blocking signature for the primary US entity. Procurement, however, is asking that it's mentioned in the amendment.

onboarding_max: Onboarding update: SAML integration is blocked — waiting on customer IdP metadata. We can delay production cutover, but we need to prepare seat provisioning for billing. Do we have a final seat count?

marta_cs: Seats are locked at 45. Also: customer prefers net60 payment terms, but our renewal standard is net30.

finance_ash: We can approve net60 as a one-off pending Rev Ops ok. For PO acceptance I need the vendor_code on the signed contract/invoice to match. I can process once signed.

sales_dan: I'll ask the customer to issue the PO quickly if we agree to net60. Suggestion: include a clause that PO must be provided within 10 business days of signature to avoid delays.

marta_cs: :eyes: Can someone in Procurement confirm vendor code mapping and update the DocuSign approver as needed? I can nudge the customer from my side.

legal_jane: I'll push a redline today that narrows the residency language; if it's just an optional reference, Legal is fine with an amendment rather than rewriting the master contract.

docusign-bot: Reminder: Envelope 0x9fa expires in 7 days. Status: awaiting procurement_manager@lakeshore.com

csm_jordan: I'll reach out to procurement manager now and confirm approver email + PO timing. @sales_dan — want me to copy you on the note?

sales_dan: Yes, please loop me.

marta_cs: Thanks team. Action items: Jordan -> confirm approver email & nudge PO; Legal -> redline DPA + propose amendment; Finance -> pre-approve net60 one-off pending Rev Ops signoff; Onboarding -> prepare provisioning plan once PO is in. I'll follow up with the customer after EOD and post an update here.

sales_dan: :thumbsup:

marta_cs: Update: procurement manager confirmed — procurement.manager@lakeshore.com. I updated the DocuSign recipients and resent the envelope.
